title: The American Foundations Committee spent $254K opposing Thom R. Sen. Tillis for the Senate (NC)
summary: The American Foundations Committee reported $254,000.00 opposing Thom R. Sen. Tillis for the Senate (NC): Media Buy, paid to Up On Air Buying, LLC. Seen from 2019-10-14; reported 2019-10-15, as filed with the FEC.
